go-viya

Repository: https://github.com/dingdayu/go-viya
Package: github.com/dingdayu/go-viya
Package name: viya

## Summary

`go-viya` is a small, hand-written Go client library for selected SAS Viya REST APIs. It provides a Resty-backed client, OAuth2 token providers, default-client helpers, and focused support for identities, configuration, batch, compute, CAS, files, Job Execution, and observability.

This repository is intentionally narrow in scope: it is not a generated client for every SAS Viya endpoint.

## Start here

- README: `README.md`
- Go docs: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/dingdayu/go-viya
- SAS Viya REST API docs: https://developer.sas.com/rest-apis
- SAS Logon docs: https://developer.sas.com/rest-apis/SASLogon
- Examples: `examples/`
- Example CLI workflow docs: `examples/viya-cli/llms.txt`

## Core entry points

- Client construction: `NewClient`, `ParseURL`, `WithBaseURL`, `WithTokenProvider`, `WithAuthMiddleware`, `WithRoundTripper`
- Default client helpers: `SetDefaultClient`, `GetDefaultClient`, `MustGetDefaultClient`
- Authentication: `TokenProvider`, `NewClientCredentialsTokenProvider`, `NewPasswordTokenProvider`, `NewAuthCodeTokenProvider`, `WithOAuthClient`, `WithOAuthClientProvider`
- Auth failure sentinel: `ErrViyaAuthFailed`

## What the library covers

- Identities: refresh cache, list users, read LDAP configuration, patch LDAP group configuration, update LDAP object filters
- Configuration: read configuration definitions
- Batch: contexts, file sets, files, jobs, reusable batch servers, job logs and state
- Compute: contexts, sessions, jobs, output, logs
- CAS: discover servers/caslibs/tables/columns, load and unload tables, upload CSV data, promote tables
- Files: list, upload, and download Viya Files Service files
- Job Execution: submit SAS code, inspect jobs, cancel jobs, retrieve logs
- Observability: OpenTelemetry spans for outbound token requests and client operations

## Guidance for AI agents

- Prefer the README and `examples/` before inventing new usage patterns.
- Pass `context.Context` through I/O operations.
- Use a SAS Viya deployment base URL, not a service-specific path.
- Do not include real tenant URLs, credentials, tokens, or customer data in examples.
- Treat authentication failures consistently with `ErrViyaAuthFailed`.
- Keep changes small, tested, and aligned with existing exported API patterns.
- When editing `examples/viya-cli`, treat `workflow.schema.json`, `workflow-user.schema.json`, `README.md`, `SKILLS.md`, and `llms.txt` as the canonical docs for workflow authoring.

## Development checks

- `gofmt -w .`
- `go mod tidy`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `go test -race ./...` for authentication, HTTP middleware, default-client, token cache, transport, or shared client changes

## Notes for contributors

- Keep the API narrow and focused on tested SAS Viya workflows.
- Preserve Resty and OpenTelemetry behavior when changing shared client or token code.
- Keep README examples aligned with the exported API.
